title: Expressions (Memphis)
description:
Expressions with constants from Memphis.
(1-29) Casting values, using Scanner (change making program, pet store checkout) PetStore.java

Program that demonstrates using Scanner to read user input -- simulates checkout from an online pet store.

lines.explanation:
Variables that are declared with final are constants -- they can be given an initial value, but that value can't be changed later in the program.

The Java convention for naming constants is CONSTANT_NAME (unlike the convention for variableName)
The L indicates this is a long value -- needed since it's too large to fit into the int data type
